Engineering AI becomes more reliable when authoritative engineering knowledge is structured before the AI uses it.

This research area covers digital construction standards, machine-readable engineering knowledge, rule units, ontology, automatic compliance checking, BIM-linked applications, digital engineering examples, and AI-assisted engineering.

> **Structure the engineering knowledge before asking AI to reason with it.**
